messages: anya: design quickie: propose a 'quiet stream' composer state where only one primary CTA (Stop) shows while response streams. token indicator becomes a compact badge. thoughts? :thought_balloon: owen: i like it. we should make Stop terminal (no mid-stream resume). regenerate disabled until stop. copy needs to be explicit: "Stop streaming response". kai: eng note: ensure backend keeps context so regenerate works immediately after stop. analytics: playground.stream.started/stopped/regenerate.enabled. keyboard: Esc stops. mei: a11y: token badge needs aria-live="polite" + aria-atomic="true". add SR-only text when regenerate is disabled: "Regenerate disabled while streaming". do not use assertive unless error. anya: layout conflict: prompt library overlaps badge on narrow widths. options: move badge left of send, or collapse to icon. preference? owen: move left of send for most sizes, collapse to icon under 400px. kai: dev plan: introduce .playground--quiet class, shortcut binding for Esc, feature flag for experiment. will add can_resume flag in response metadata for retry UX. mei: example markup to hand off: Tokens: 198 Regenerate disabled while streaming own: action items: 1) design mocks (left vs collapsed) - @anya 2) eng implement .playground--quiet + shortcuts - @kai 3) a11y run SR pass - @mei 4) finalize copy - @owen. i'll drop analytics events. anya: thanks everyone — will post Figma frames later today. :sparkles:
